text:
nora: quick note from kite-v1 int8 bring-up: multilingual-eval-suite shows CJK punctuation spacing and occasional RTL bracket mirror issues after quant+prune. link: https://rwd.internal/evals/1766543211 :mag:

nora: summary: zh chrF -3.1, ja BLEU -1.2, ar paren-mirror +6%. small but reproducible on nightly canary.

pei: can you paste a tiny repro (fp16 -> int8) and tokenizer peek?

nora: repro snippets below (fp16 vs int8):
```
src: \u6211\u559c\u6b22\u5403\u82f9\u679c\u3002
fp16: I like eating apples.
int8: I like eating apples .  <-- extra space before ideographic full stop
```
```
src: (\u0647\u0630\u0627) \u0643\u062a\u0627\u0628
fp16: (this) book
int8: ) this ) book  <-- mirrored brackets sometimes
```

esra: tokenizer preview looks identical pre/post, but vocab diffs show one-off id moves for punctuation tokens after the prune step. example: `vocab_before['\u3002']=id_1007` vs `vocab_after['\u3002']=id_1006`.

tomas: hypothesis: aggressive token-prune is removing low-frequency multi-codepoint tokens or doing a non-stable merge that shifts nearby ids. try running without prune: `rwd evaluate --model kite-v1 --quant=int8 --no-token-prune --dataset multilingual-eval-suite`

nora: ran it — improvement: zh chrF drop reduced to -0.9, ja -0.3, ar paren-mirror nearly gone. so prune likely the culprit.

pei: short-term mitigation: add a whitelist to token-prune to preserve codepoints in ZWJ/ZWSP range and bracket/paren/punctuation codepoints for all locales. also add a stable sort during merge.

esra: created ML-2999 "kite-v1: add token-prune whitelist + stable merge to prevent locale token id drift" and assigned to @esra + @pei. https://rwd.internal/issue/ML-2999

ci-bot: ci: kite-v1-int8 build queued with whitelist patch (sha: 7f2a1c...).

peI: will add unit test that runs prune 20x and asserts token->id stability for a curated punctuation+ZWJ set and a small bisect script: `scripts/bisect_prune.sh --model kite-v1 --steps 20`.

tomas: follow-up: add token-level diff to eval UI highlighting one-off id moves for punctuation, digits, and ZWJ tokens so QA can auto-flag regressions. filed ML-3000 for UI work.

nora: thanks all. ping here if other mixed-orient regressions pop up during canary. :thumbsup:
